newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Nat'l Bank leaves discount rate at 1.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Nat'l Bank leaves discount rate at 1.0 pct.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said it left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after a regular weekly meeting of its central bank council.
"There has been no change," an SNB spokesman said.
The rate has been kept at 1.00 percent since it was lowered from 1.50 percent on September 26.
The rate at current levels matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
